headline: Spain: Hundreds of thousands of protesters for the right to housing and purchasing power
summary: Hundreds of thousands of people demonstrated across Spain, including in Madrid and Barcelona, at the end of a general strike day over housing and purchasing power, less than three weeks before early elections.
why: Spain's cost-of-living and housing policies influence fiscal spending, the political outlook and the country's sovereign risk for investors.
